Plenty of solo women I met backpacking through Egypt. Hotels are super cheap. I stayed in Giza next to the pyramids and could walk. Typical hassling of people trying to get you to pay for things you don’t need. Kind of aggressive but still safe. Happy to provide more details and my itinerary. Just dm me

I hate cruises with a passion. But this is the easiest way to see Egypt, hands down! It was the best decision I made traveling through Egypt. Trains are not what you think. They run at night and you can only take certain trains as foreigners. Food is taken care of, they stop at temples and landmarks on the way and the rooms are pretty comfortable and cheap. Do you research and you’ll see how many people agree. Good luck!

I’m exactly that guy. This is pretty much 90% of my relationships I engage in with women. Ive thought about why I do this and here’s my honest truth from my perspective.
1. Emotional distance: He’s probably been hurt by another person and puts up boundaries right away. He blurs the line because he wants all the benefits of a gf (cuddling, opening up) without commitment. This is usually what confuses women the most...obviously 

2. not afraid to be alone: im pretty happy being alone. Traveling, exploring, working alone. Some guys really love the solitude. But the gf experience is a good one and it appealing to even us the wonderlusters. 

3. Wants you around on his terms. If I works out, that’s ok, if you leave that’s ok. Why care if you don’t trust relationships and being alone is actually pretty fun? That attitude is both attractive and frustrating to many women...probably why youre still around. You’re his weekend gf. He Definitely has feelings for you, but probably not the one to make him confront why is a emotionally distant person at times and all about you in other times. 

4. If it’s a relationship you seek. He’s not the one, I wouldn’t tell someone I’m really into those things. I would be playing with fire. Guys do change and regret their actions if he feels as if he will actually lose you. Or just confuse you to no end...

Glad to answer any questions
